name: Furnace Plate
description: a brimstone demon of the Cracked Road: a hunched body of cracked black basalt with molten orange light glowing through every seam, short curved horns of charred stone, small burning ember eyes, a wide jaw with a furnace glow inside, its iron plate shield glowing red-hot like a furnace door with a grille, heat haze around it, flames licking out of its seams

poses.stand: standing hunched behind its red-hot furnace-door plate, flames licking from its seams
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

move.action: trudges forward behind its glowing furnace plate, heat haze rippling, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: rises behind the red-hot plate and flicks two small glowing rock shards over the top of it forward to the right, a little puff of smoke

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
